llm_response.reason: Multiple scam characteristics detected: 1) The site mimics the legitimate Cotopaxi brand but domain registrant is in China with unrelated contact info, suggesting spoofing (Characteristic 16); 2) No company registration, phone number, or business address (Characteristic 4, 6); 3) Domain and contact email do not match, and the customer support email is also unrelated (Characteristic 6); 4) SSL certificate issues and recent domain registration (Characteristic 9); 5) Payment page is present but payment methods not shown clearly, raising questions (Characteristic 8); 6) No verified testimonials, privacy, or clarity in customer information protection (Characteristic 7). These combine to show a high risk of fake online shopping scam typical of fraudulent brand clone sites.
